title: Japan Family Odyssey with Both Parks
alt: Illuminated tunnel of lights at Nabana no Sato, Japan
transport: Bullet train, private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji and Disneyland
stops.accom: 5 nights · Breakfast · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Shinjuku, a short walk from the station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day from the LOVE statue in Shinjuku through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and the temple lanes of Asakusa.

activities.name: Mount Fuji, Hakone and Gotemba outlets
activities.match: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
activities.description: The fifth station on Mount Fuji, Lake Ashi in Hakone and a shopping stop at the Gotemba outlets on the way back.

activities.name: Tokyo Disneyland
activities.description: A full day at Tokyo Disneyland with your admission tickets included, so you can be at the gates when the park opens.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Five nights in one Shinjuku hotel with a city day, Mount Fuji with the Gotemba outlets, a free day and Tokyo Disneyland.

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.subtitle: Kyoto to Nara and Arashiyama
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 3★ · Small ryokan in the Gion lanes, tatami rooms and a shared bath

activities.name: Kyoto and Nara day trip
activities.description: Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, then the deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara, which holds the great bronze Buddha.

activities.name: Arashiyama and the Sagano scenic train
activities.description: The bamboo grove at Arashiyama and a ride on the open sided Sagano scenic train along the Hozugawa river gorge.

program.name: Kyoto
program.description: Two ryokan nights in Gion, with a day that takes in Kyoto, Nara and the bamboo grove and scenic train at Arashiyama.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Universal Studios and Nabana no Sato
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel opposite Shin-Osaka station, handy for the trains

activities.name: Osaka walking tour
activities.description: Half a day on foot through Dotonbori, the Kuromon market and the lanes around Shinsekai with a guide who knows where to eat.

activities.name: Universal Studios Japan
activities.description: A full day at Universal Studios Japan with tickets included, home to Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area.

activities.name: Sakura Magic and Nabana no Sato illumination
activities.match: Sakura Magic & Nabana no Sato Tour
activities.description: Blossom gardens by day and then Nabana no Sato after dark, where millions of lights are strung into tunnels and fields.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Three nights to finish with a walking tour, Universal Studios Japan and an evening at the Nabana no Sato illuminations.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Five nights in one Tokyo hotel with a free day in the middle is what makes eleven days work with children.
expert.tip: Put the ryokan night in the middle of the trip, not at the start. By Kyoto the children are used to the food and the shoes-off routine is fun rather than strange.

summary: Eleven days for a family: five nights in Shinjuku with a city day, Mount Fuji with the Gotemba outlets and Tokyo Disneyland, two ryokan nights in Gion with Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama, then three in Osaka with Universal Studios and the Nabana no Sato illuminations.
included: Included: 10 nights with breakfast on most mornings; bullet trains between Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka; private airport transfers; Tokyo sightseeing tour; Mount Fuji fifth station with Hakone and the Gotemba outlets; Tokyo Disneyland tickets; Kyoto and Nara day trip; Arashiyama with the Sagano scenic train; Osaka walking tour; Universal Studios Japan tickets; Sakura Magic and Nabana no Sato tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
